title: RegExr: Temporarily Offline
excerpt: RegExr is temporarily offline while we modernize and secure the site.
content_html:
RegExr’s codebase is aging, and with AI hacking we’ve decided the best way to safekeep your data is to take the site down until we get a chance to modernize and secure it.

Our sincere apologies for the outage! Hopefully we’ll be back soon.
